content.title: 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA Heart Failure Guideline
content.section_overview: The guideline discusses mechanical circulatory support (MCS) with a focus on various studies relating to heart failure treatments, including the utilization of left ventricular assist devices (LVADs), heart transplantation, and different intervention methodologies among patients with advanced heart failure.
key_sections: Use of continuous-outpatient support systems for patients with refractory end-stage heart failure.
Treatment comparisons for acute decompensated heart failure using intravenous vasoactive medications.
Long-term outcomes of heart transplantation and LVAD support in heart failure patients.
Survival rates and outcomes associated with peripheral and central extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO) procedures.
